selectors.roles: U and G0 are independently profiled controls. Identical Gluon candidates may alias only after exact full-CUBIN, ABI, runtime specialization and launch-resource checks.
selectors.selection_basis: Static case/subtype and declared layout intervention only; no candidate timing files are read.
selectors.timing_read_policy: This program accepts only a compiler-artifact payload. It never opens timing directories, analysis.json, timing.csv or performance reports.
